question:
**Select the most appropriate synonym of the underlined word.**

We __expended__ most of our savings on this tour.
solution:
The correct answer is **exhausted**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Expended: **spent or used money, time, care, etc. in doing something.
 
• **Exhausted: **depleted of energy, force, or strength.
 
 
• Example: "We've exhausted all our options to solve this problem."
 
 
 
• Thus, the most appropriate synonym of the underlined word is **exhausted**.

Thus, the correct answer is **option 1.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Earned: The verb "earned" refers to having received something in return for labor or services, it can also be used to suggest that something was deserved because of actions or qualities.
 
 
• **Example:** "She earned a good salary from her job."
 
 
 
• Enjoyed: The verb "enjoyed" means to have derived pleasure from something or to have a pleasant or satisfying experience.
 
 
• **Example: **"We really enjoyed our vacation in Hawaii." 
 
 
 
• Encashed: The verb "encashed" means to convert a check or other financial instrument into cash; it is often used in contexts like encashing a check or bond.
 
 
• **Example: **"I encashed my paycheck at the bank." e.g., "He encashed his savings bonds when he needed the money."
